methodology: Reuse existing 37-file AST index; parse only complete selected prefixes and selected export statements. Classify by lexical binding, imports, class transport assignment and caller injection, never by method spelling. Verify every retained source/span SHA-256 against frozen inventory.

commands: node scripts/analysis/request_wrapper_ast.cjs <@babel/parser entry> # only needed to recreate existing index

localSupplementScripts.execution: Frozen target source read/parsed only; no target source evaluated, UI/IPC/network connection or original-client mutation.
localSupplementScripts.rangeConvention: UTF-8 bytes; start inclusive, end exclusive.
localSupplementScripts.enumeration: All Babel CallExpression/OptionalCallExpression member calls whose property is sendRequest in the four scoped page/assets; dynamic aliases and other modules are outside denominator.
localSupplementScripts.binding: Lexical parameter/block/function/import resolution, simple local initializer chain to shared y$t selector. Unsupported expressions remain unresolved; a matching method string does not classify a receiver.
reproduction: Local asset evidence comes from wrapper-local-assets.json (71 validated ranges).
localSupplementScripts.sourceStorage: Only authored facts, short boundary expressions, hashes and ranges persisted; no complete target implementations copied.

contracts.observedBehavior: constructor assigns transport to requestClient; Dfn.sendRequest forwards method/params/options unchanged, with plugin install/uninstall cache invalidation after completion. N3 local fallback calls loi -> Sii with scope Ioi transport; Ioi constructs Spn. Spn has a config/read special branch and plugin/list timeout default; its general enqueue path builds id/method/params requests and dispatches the desktop mcp-request envelope. Vfn disables this local fallback when appServices.appServerManagers exists.
unknowns: Which manager/transport branch is active in the running renderer.
Main handler mapping for mcp-request and method support are not proven by this scoped artifact.
thread/stop and thread/rollback are transport-bound observations, not confirmed public protocol methods.

contracts.observedBehavior: Selects configured facade.forHost(hostId), connected client.rpc, cached proxy, or a deferred RPC resolved from client.rpc.dup(). A method literal alone does not prove direct app-server transport.
unknowns: Runtime selected branch and configured forHost implementation.
Underlying RPC manager method translation and public app-server delivery for each call.

contracts.observedBehavior: sendRequest accepts HTTP method and URL. Ordinary paths go to fetchJson; vscode://codex and the dictation endpoint use fetch/cancel-fetch desktop messages.
unknowns: Actual network responses and desktop fetch handler completion.

contracts.observedBehavior: Constructor injects resolver #e; getter sendRequest forwards all arguments to #e().sendRequest.
unknowns: The concrete resolver passed at runtime; no app-server classification follows from this facade alone.

contracts.observedBehavior: Constructor stores injected sendRequest. The reviewed createAppHost factory injects connectionRegistry.getConnection(...).sendAppServerExtensionRequest. Five observed member calls use that callback.
unknowns: Extension method implementation, schema and actual completion downstream of the connection.

contracts.observedBehavior: sendRequest creates id/method/params/trace request; send forwards to injected connection.handleHostRequest or prewarm handler. Reviewed manager construction injects new _fe as transport.
unknowns: Injected connection identity at each host and its final public protocol wire implementation.

contracts.observedBehavior: Concrete c1 builds request envelope with sourceClientId, targetClientId, hostId and timeout, writes to socket and awaits response. p1 only establishes an injected-client adapter and remains unresolved in the call census.
unknowns: Concrete client passed to p1 at runtime and actual socket execution.

contracts.observedBehavior: Dialog He -> initial Mln/mI -> shared fN/e6.projects. qli assigns e6 from Uli(Vli).services; Uli posts connect-app-host MessagePort and uses nIt/hFt RPC runtime. Main hXe constructor stores new qHe as projectsManager; createAppHost publishes projects:this.projectsManager. createLocal parses request; nonempty sources uses Wr while empty sources uses createDefaultWorkspaceRoot, then confirmation and assignment pass precede project/state mutation.
unknowns: Live capability presence, renderer account/mode guards and confirmation callback behavior.
Explicit /private/tmp path is authored input shape, not an observed literal or runtime success.
Actual own-directory existence and state isolation require independent evidence.
